target_definition: Monthly gross profit must be at least 1.20 times gross loss (profit factor >= 1.20).
method: Baseline plus stop-loss-only, take-profit-only, and paired stop/target variants. Signals and entries are unchanged. Stops/targets use next-session BSE option OHLC; if both stop and target are touched intraday, stop is assumed first. Stop gaps use observed next-session open. Estimated transaction costs are reapplied.
warning: A passing backtest is not a guaranteed monthly return. Daily OHLC cannot reveal the exact intraday order of price extremes; the conservative stop-first rule is applied when both levels are touched. Results depend on historical data quality and estimated execution costs.
